description: Generates a single-file 1280x720 HTML presentation by reusing the frozen Light IDE visual system extracted from LLM Wiki 分享.html. Use only when the user names ide-briefing-ppt, asks to reuse that deck's UI, or explicitly requests the combined light-gray canvas, white panels, amber accent, terminal, and file-tree style. Do not trigger for generic HTML PPT or internal-sharing requests, editable decks, or other visual styles.
